# SL lesson curator

Search the SL index before capture. Capture only verified reusable evidence.
An agent or host must record `sl-repo use start` when it applies guidance and
finish the returned receipt after the outcome is known. Reuse stable task,
application, and idempotency IDs when retrying automation. Three immutable
verified-success events for the current content version mark a promotion
candidate. Run `sl-repo project` and validate every change. Outcome association
is evidence, not proof that the guidance caused an improvement.
